segs.p: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, cakkhussa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: “Mendicants, the arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of the eye is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.
The arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of the ear,

segs.p: yo manassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: and mind is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca, bhikkhave, cakkhussa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo.
segs.e: The cessation, settling, and disappearance of the eye is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.
The cessation, settling, and disappearance of the ear,

segs.p: yo manassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: and mind is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.”

segs.p: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, rūpānaṁ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: “Mendicants, the arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of sights is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.
The arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of sounds,

segs.p: yo dhammānaṁ uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: and ideas is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpānaṁ nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo.
segs.e: The cessation, settling, and disappearance of sights,

segs.p: yo dhammānaṁ nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: and ideas is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.”

segs.e: “Mendicants, the arising of feeling born of eye contact …
the arising of feeling born of mind contact …
is the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo …pe…
segs.e: The cessation of feeling born of eye contact …

segs.p: yo manosamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: the cessation of feeling born of mind contact … is the disappearance of old age and death.”
“Mendicants, the arising of perception of sights …

segs.p: yo dhammasaññāya uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: perception of ideas … is the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpasaññāya nirodho …pe…
segs.e: The cessation of perception of sights …

segs.p: yo dhammasaññāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: perception of ideas … is the disappearance of old age and death.”
“Mendicants, the arising of intentions regarding sights …

segs.p: yo dhammasañcetanāya uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: intentions regarding ideas … is the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpasañcetanāya nirodho …pe…
segs.e: The cessation of intentions regarding sights …

segs.p: yo dhammasañcetanāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: intentions regarding ideas … is the disappearance of old age and death.”
“Mendicants, the arising of craving for sights …

segs.p: yo dhammataṇhāya uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: craving for ideas … is the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpataṇhāya nirodho …pe…
segs.e: The cessation of craving for sights …

segs.p: yo dhammataṇhāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: craving for ideas … is the disappearance of old age and death.”

segs.p: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo;
segs.e: “Mendicants, the arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of the earth element,

segs.p: yo viññāṇadhātuyā uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: and the consciousness element is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātuyā nirodho …pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo;
segs.e: The cessation of the earth element,

segs.p: yo viññāṇadhātuyā nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: and the consciousness element is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.”

segs.p: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, rūpassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: “Mendicants, the arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of form is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.
The arising, continuation, and manifestation and regeneration of feeling,

segs.p: yo viññāṇassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṁ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
segs.e: and consciousness is the arising of suffering, the continuation of diseases, and the manifestation of old age and death.

segs.p: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo.
segs.e: The cessation, settling, and disappearance of form is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.
The cessation, settling, and disappearance of feeling,

segs.p: yo viññāṇassa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
segs.e: and consciousness is the cessation of suffering, the settling of diseases, and the disappearance of old age and death.”
